q: An electron flies parallel to a magnetic field. How large a magnetic force acts on it?
a: None at all. $F = qvB\sin\alpha$, and in motion parallel to the field $\alpha = 0^\circ$, so $\sin 0^\circ = 0$ and $F = 0$.
